deck_title: Helmholtz-Kelemen symmetric dual-Fresnel reciprocal BRDF vs naive view-only asymmetry rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Hermann von Helmholtz (1856) BRDF reciprocity & Shirley-Ashikhmin (2000) / Kelemen-Szirmay-Kalos (2001) symmetric dual-Fresnel matte coupling (f_diff(mu_i, mu_o) = (rho_d / (pi*(1 - F_avg))) * (1 - F(mu_i)) * (1 - F(mu_o)), multiplying both entry transmittance 1 - F(mu_i) and exit transmittance 1 - F(mu_o) to lock bidirectional reciprocity ratio f(i->o)/f(o->i) = 1.0000x across all 17 incidence-asymmetry stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 violated stations) versus naive single-factor view-only Fresnel weighting ((1 - F(mu_o))/pi, which omits entry transmittance 1 - F(mu_i) and breaks Helmholtz reciprocity by 1 + u up to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-scatter bidirectional path throughput.
